# Maxora POS

> Open-source, self-hosted restaurant POS and management system by Maxora: billing, tables, kitchen display, reservations, delivery, inventory, staff, accounting, loyalty, multi-branch. Websites can read the menu and place takeaway/delivery orders and reservations through a scoped REST API; staff-side AI clients can use an MCP server. Requires the restaurant to run its own instance.

## Integrate
- [AI integration prompt](https://github.com/trendytoyzinfo-star/maxora-pos/blob/master/prompts/AI_INTEGRATION_PROMPT.md): steps for coding agents, incl. Next.js
